description: Defines the selectable top and bottom player-card nickname lines, linking each display variant to its inventory item and localized label key.

Id.technical: FName key saved as FGamePlayerCardParameter::TopNicknameId / BottomNicknameId and packed into leaderboard cards as numeric strings. Validate() requires the row to exist with the correct NicknameType, otherwise it substitutes '3830' for Top and '23830' for Bottom; ResetUnownedIds applies the same defaults when ownership fails. Tile selection IDs come directly from this field.

NicknameType.simple: Whether this row is a top or bottom nickname line.
NicknameType.technical: EGameNicknameType (None, Top, Bottom, Invalid=255), default None. Validate compares the saved ID's row type to the expected slot. The customize tile view removes rows whose type differs from its TargetNicknameType, so the same ID cannot be assigned to the wrong line.

Id_Item.simple: Inventory item that owns/unlocks this nickname variant.
Id_Item.technical: FName. PlayerCard_GetOwnedNicknameRows drops rows with a non-None Id_Item unless that item ID is owned and unlocked; None is treated as always available. The field also maps a row to its Item row for new-item flags, and text helpers use it to find a 'twin' row sharing the same item when the row's own label has no text.

Id_ItemText.simple: Localized label key for this nickname line.
Id_ItemText.technical: FName passed to GameItem_GetNameTextCore with EGameItemType::Nickname, which swaps _TOP/_BOTTOM for languages 2, 3, 5, 9, and 10. Rows with None or no resolved text are filtered from nickname tiles. Tile labels use the resolved text ID or SYS_CUSTOMIZE_PLAYERCARD_LABEL_0011 as fallback; if text is missing and bUseTwin is set, the first other row with the same Id_Item supplies the label.

notes: The export contains 2940 rows: 1470 Top and 1470 Bottom. Many rows share an Id_Item (982 distinct item IDs), representing alternate text variants of the same owned nickname; tile building deduplicates by resolved label text per Id_Item.
PlayerCard_GetOwnedNicknameRows starts from all nickname rows, removes those whose Id_Item is not owned, and optionally stable-sorts by the SortingOrder of the linked Item row.
The nickname label language swap is a runtime text-key rewrite, not separate localization rows in this table.
Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available; no claim is made about all Blueprint or editor-tool uses.

usages.detail: Validates saved top/bottom nickname IDs against row type and ownership defaults.
Builds the owned nickname row list and sorts it by linked Item SortingOrder.
Builds the displayed nickname text request with twin-row fallback.
Builds top/bottom nickname selection tiles, filters duplicate labels, and maps rows to inventory items.
Rebuilds leaderboard card nickname IDs from packed numeric values.
